remarks: The rental you've been waiting for - a rare find. Some homes just feel right the moment you walk in. This beautifully maintained townhouse is one of them. Sunlight pours into the living room, setting the tone for a home that's as comfortable as it is stylish. The flow into the renovated kitchen and dining area is effortless - think gleaming stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and sliding doors that open onto your own private large deck. Whether it's morning coffee or evening entertaining, this space delivers. Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms offer the retreat you deserve, with a full bath and the everyday luxury of an in-unit full-size washer and dryer. Rich hardwood floors run throughout, tying it all together with warmth and elegance. Set within a meticulously landscaped, well-kept community, you're steps from trains, schools, restaurants, and everyday conveniences. Newfield Green Shopping Center is steps aways. This is the kind of location that makes life genuinely easier.
